name: Assemblée des représentants du peuple
notes: Lower house of the Tunisian parliament, seated in Bardo. The member list on arp.tn gives names only (no bloc or constituency), so no seat chart yet.

name: Conseil national des régions et des districts
notes: Second chamber; its opinion on finance bills is consultative. Seat count from the chamber's own member list (77 names with governorate and region); the list shows no party, so the chart has one group.

name: Government of Tunisia
notes: The executive; Minister of Finance Michket Salama Khaldi tabled the 2026 wealth tax.
